data.text: I’d support Emma’s 18-ton limit this month. Luke’s 19 is safe if everyone sticks to it, but leaves no margin for an extra ton. Leaving 10 also gives us a stronger starting point if replenishment fails. Let’s agree that when stock is 10 or less, everyone catches zero, and rotate any extra whole tons under the future shared limit. Since catches are revealed afterward, we can check compliance before making the next agreement. John, can you commit to 18 this month?
